instructions: Cleve notes, folders and skills live in workspaces (organizations), and an account can belong to several. Every workspace tool accepts an optional `organization` argument (an org id or exact name). Call cleve_list_orgs first to see the workspaces and which one this client currently targets. If a call fails because no workspace is selected, pass `organization`, or call cleve_switch_org once to save a default for this client. Every Cleve note has a URL: https://app.cleve.ai/notes/NOTE_ID. Replace NOTE_ID with the exact note ID (noteId, id, or _id) returned by a tool or supplied in the active note context. Public, link-shared, and private notes all use /notes/<noteId>; do not use /share/<noteId> or /user/<slug>/<noteId> for a note link. Never invent an ID. In chat replies, use a clickable Markdown link when delivering a created note or when the user asks to open or link a note; prefer the url returned by the tool. A note URL does not grant access or make the note public: existing sharing permissions still apply.

tools.name: cleve_update_html_block
tools.title: Update interactive block
tools.description:
Replace the markup of an interactive HTML block (a `html cleve-block` widget) that already exists in a note. Use this rather than cleve_replace_in_note when rewriting a widget: it takes the whole markup at once, so you never have to match a long unique string.

Identify the block by `index` (0-based, counting only HTML blocks in the order they appear, including any nested in a quote, list or table) or by its exact `title`, which must match one block only. Pass `newTitle` to change its caption.

Sandbox rules the markup must respect:
- Inline <style> and <script> work.
- Data fetching is blocked: fetch, XHR, WebSocket, and beacons all fail. The block cannot reach the network for data.
- Scripts, stylesheets, fonts and images MAY load from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net. Everything else is blocked by the Content Security Policy.
- Load libraries as classic `<script src>` UMD builds from those two CDNs. `<script type="module">` importing from esm.sh, unpkg or skypack is blocked — use the UMD build instead. React is available that way (react + react-dom UMD), but plain DOM code is usually simpler.
- Small images may be inline data: URIs; larger ones should come from the two allowed CDNs.
- Keep the whole block under 100 KB of markup.
- The block sizes itself; do not set a fixed body height.

index.description: 0-based HTML-block index in document order, including nested blocks. Provide this or title, not both.

title.description: Exact title matching one HTML block only. Provide this or index, not both.

tools.name: cleve_view_note
tools.title: View note with line numbers
tools.description: Show a note as Markdown with line numbers, followed by its open comment threads. Call this before cleve_replace_in_note or cleve_insert_in_note, so you copy text and line numbers from the current note. Threads also appear in the note's Markdown: commented text is wrapped in `…`, and open threads are listed in an "## Open comments" appendix below the note body. The appendix is not part of the note — never edit it or copy it into the note.

noteId.description: Note ID from cleve_search_notes, cleve_list_recent_notes, or cleve_list_notes_in_folder.

viewRange.description: [startLine, endLine], inclusive and 1-indexed; use -1 for the end. Omit to show the whole note.

organization.description: Workspace to act in: an org id or exact name from cleve_list_orgs. Omit to use this client's saved selection, or your only workspace.
